note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Japanese, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-ja-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-ja). Every Scripture quotation and verbatim recitation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-19: Japanese quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 口語訳 (japkougo) wording the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a quotation or recitation whose every piece, pieces joined by '……' allowed, is a verbatim span of the cited OWB verse(s); OWB's inner quote marks become 『』 inside a quotation. A `self_rendered` or `allusion` row carries its reason in `why` where the re-quote wrote it: a reading OWB cannot serve, a version comparison, or Spurgeon's own paraphrase. Rows with `chapter_order` were written by the re-quote; the rows without it are the original translator's allusion rows, unchanged.
